title: Multi-site Ultrasound-guided Fine Needle Aspiration from Human Lymph Nodes
author: Al-Diwani, Agrawal, et al.
materials: Ultrasound machine and probe (GE Healthcare LOGIQ E10, or equivalent)
Eight 1.5-ml Eppendorf tubes, each pre-filled with 1 ml sterile Dulbecco's phosphate-buffered saline (D-PBS)

steps.title: Prepare Materials
steps.instruction: Gather 2% (w/v) lidocaine hydrochloride, R10 medium, 5 21-G needles, 5 5-ml syringes, and 5 15-ml conical tubes.

steps.title: Prepare the Patient
steps.instruction: Prepare the patient for the procedure by explaining the process and obtaining informed consent.

steps.title: Position the Patient
steps.instruction: Position the patient in a comfortable position, ideally with the affected lymph node accessible.

steps.title: Clean and Prepare the Skin
steps.instruction: Clean the skin over the affected lymph node with an antiseptic solution and allow it to dry.

steps.title: Administer Local Anesthesia
steps.instruction: Administer 2% (w/v) lidocaine hydrochloride to the affected area to numb it.

steps.title: Prepare the Ultrasound Equipment
steps.instruction: Prepare the ultrasound equipment and adjust the settings to optimize image quality.

steps.title: Locate the Lymph Node
steps.instruction: Use the ultrasound equipment to locate the affected lymph node and position the needle accordingly.

steps.title: Insert the Needle
steps.instruction: Insert the 21-G needle into the lymph node under ultrasound guidance.

steps.title: Aspirate the Sample
steps.instruction: Aspirate the sample from the lymph node using a 5-ml syringe.

steps.title: Transfer the Sample
steps.instruction: Transfer the aspirated sample to a 15-ml conical tube containing R10 medium.

steps.title: Dispose of the Needle
steps.instruction: Dispose of the used needle and syringe according to proper protocols.
